body:
**[comments] Rule 5, a call-site comment says only why here: shorten**

The clause "the AVX-512 reader of VNNI K" describes the callee. That description is the first sentence of k_vnni.hpp's own header comment and of qk_group's comment, so the include line keeps only the symbol it is there for.

Proposed:
```cpp
#include "tron/kernels/k_vnni.hpp"  // qk_group
```
reply: Just remove the inline comment, `// qk_group......`
